sanskrit: idaṃ rāṣṭraṃ prathatāṃ gobhir aśvair idaṃ rāṣṭram annenerayā rasena | asmai ṣaḍ urvīr upa saṃ namantu saptahotrā hata śatrūn sacittāḥ ||
english: May this kingdom spread wide with cattle and horses; may this kingdom spread with food, with vitality, with sap. May the six broad regions bow together before it; O seven-priests, slay the enemies with one accord.

sanskrit: ime rājāna iṣubhir ghnantu śatrūn ime rājānaḥ samityānyān vadheyuḥ | ime rājānaḥ pṛtanāḥ sahantām ahaṃ brahmā vi mṛdho hanmi sarvāḥ ||
english: May these kings smite the enemies with arrows; may these kings slay others in the assembly of battle. May these kings overcome their armies — I the brahman-priest crush all the hostile forces.

sanskrit: idaṃ rāṣṭraṃ kratumad vīravaj jiṣṇūgram idaṃ rāṣṭraṃ gardnumac citraghoṣam | asmai rāṣṭrāya balim anye harantv ahaṃ devebhyo haviṣā vidheyam ||
english: May this kingdom be endowed with wisdom, with heroes, victorious and fierce; may this kingdom be glorious and resounding with wondrous clamour. Let others bring tribute to this kingdom; may I be obedient to the gods with oblation.

sanskrit: yadi yuddhaṃ yady ṛtitaṃ vo asti devainasād yadi vā pitryeṇa | yenarttīyā dhenavo astu tasmā ahaṃ devebhyo haviṣā juhomi ||
english: Whether there is battle among you, whether there is transgression — whether from a sin against the gods or from an ancestral guilt — whatever makes the milk-kine run dry because of it, on that account I pour oblation to the gods.

sanskrit: yad vaḥ krūraṃ manaso yac ca vāco devainasād yadi vā pitryeṇa | āpa iva duḥṣvapnyam apa tat svapadhvam athānandinaḥ sumanasaḥ sam eta ||
english: Whatever is cruel in your minds and in your speech — whether from a sin against the gods or from an ancestral guilt — sleep that away like a bad dream as waters cast off impurity; then come together rejoicing and of good mind.

sanskrit: apām iva vegaḥ pra śṛṇīta śatrūn diśodiśo rabhamāṇaḥ sam eta | ekavratā vi dhanaṃ bhajadhvaṃ purohitena vo rāṣṭraṃ prathayantu devāḥ ||
english: Like the rush of waters, shatter the enemies; come together pressing in from every direction. United in a single vow, share out the wealth; may the gods, with your purohita, cause your kingdom to spread.

sanskrit: samyag vo rāṣṭraṃ saha vo manāṃsi samīcīnāḥ paśavo viśvarūpāḥ | samīcīnānāṃ vo aham asmi brahmā samyañco devā havam ā yantu ma imam ||
english: United is your kingdom, united are your minds; your cattle of every form face together in accord. For you who are thus united I am the brahman-priest; may the gods, united, come to this invocation of mine.

sanskrit: yathāpaḥ samudrāya samīcīr vahatha śriyam | evā rāṣṭrāya me devāḥ samyañco vahata śriyam ||
english: As waters, flowing together toward the ocean, carry prosperity, so, O gods, flowing together, carry prosperity to my kingdom.

sanskrit: saṃsṛṣṭaṃ vo rāṣṭraṃ paśubhir gobhir aśvaiḥ saṃsṛṣṭam annenerayā rasena | mayā brahmaṇā prathamānāśvo vasīyāṃsaḥ sadam ugrā bhavātha ||
english: Commingled is your kingdom with livestock, with cattle, with horses; commingled with food, with vitality, with sap. By me the brahman-priest, foremost among horses — may you ever be stronger, ever fierce.

sanskrit: bahur yuvā pramṛṇo dhṛṣṇur astu bahuḥ kumāraḥ pratirūpaḥ pitṝṇām | satyaṃ vadantaḥ samitiṃ caranto mitraṃ gṛhṇānā jaraso yantu sakhyam ||
english: Let there be many a young man, a crusher of foes, bold; many a youth resembling the likeness of his fathers. Speaking truth, attending the assembly, embracing friendship — may they reach old age in companionship.

sanskrit: iha kṣatraṃ dyumnam uta rāṣṭraṃ samaitv ihendriyaṃ paśubhiḥ saṃvidānam | avadhunvānā apriyān yāṃś ca dviṣma idaṃ rāṣṭraṃ prathatāṃ sarvadaiva ||
english: Let the kṣatra and the splendour and the kingdom converge here; let the power of the senses, in accord with the livestock, gather here. Shaking off those who are hostile and those whom we hate, may this kingdom spread wide for all time.

sanskrit: idaṃ rāṣṭram iṣumad vīravaj jiṣṇūgram idaṃ rāṣṭraṃ paśumad brahmavṛddham | idaṃ rāṣṭraṃ hataśatru jiṣṇu ||
english: May this kingdom be rich in arrows, rich in heroes, victorious and fierce; may this kingdom be rich in cattle, grown great in brahman power. May this kingdom, with its enemies slain, be victorious.

sanskrit: sapatnasāhaṃ pramṛṇam idaṃ rāṣṭraṃ dṛḍham ugram | sāḍhāmitram abhimātiṣāhaṃ sarvā jigāya pṛtanā abhiṣṭi ||
english: Overpowering rivals, crushing all — may this kingdom be firm and fierce. Overwhelming the enemy, conquering all assailants — by its onslaught has it vanquished every army.

sanskrit: audumbareṇa maṇiṇā puṣṭikāmāya vedhasā | paśūnāṃ sarveṣāṃ sphātiṃ goṣṭhe me savitā karat ||
english: With the amulet of the udumbara tree, for the wise man who desires prosperity — may Savitṛ grant me the thriving of all the cattle in the cowpen.

sanskrit: yo no agnir gārhapatyaḥ paśūnām adhipā asat | audumbaro vṛṣā maṇiḥ saṃ mā sṛjatu puṣṭyā ||
english: He who is our Agni Gārhapatya, who shall be the overlord of the cattle — may the udumbara amulet, that virile talisman, unite me with prosperity.

sanskrit: karīṣiṇīṃ phalavatīṃ svadhām irāṃ ca no gṛhe | audumbarasya tejasā dhātā puṣṭiṃ dadhātu me ||
english: Rich in dung-fuel, fruit-bearing, the ancestral share and refreshment — in our home, by the radiance of the udumbara, may Dhātṛ bestow prosperity upon me.

sanskrit: yad dvipāc ca catuṣpāc ca yāny annāni ye rasāḥ | gṛhṇe 'haṃ teṣāṃ bhūmānaṃ bibhrad audumbaraṃ maṇim ||
english: Whatever foods and saps belong to the two-footed and the four-footed — I seize the abundance of all those, bearing the udumbara amulet.

sanskrit: puṣṭiṃ paśūnāṃ pari jagrabhāhaṃ catuṣpadāṃ dvipadāṃ yac ca dhānyam | payaḥ paśūnāṃ rasam oṣadhīnāṃ bṛhaspatiḥ savitā me ni yacchāt ||
english: I have grasped round about the prosperity of the livestock — of the four-footed, the two-footed, and whatever is grain. May Bṛhaspati and Savitṛ bestow upon me the milk of the cattle and the sap of the herbs.

sanskrit: ahaṃ paśūnām adhipā asāni mayi puṣṭaṃ puṣṭapatir dadhātu | mahyam audumbaro maṇir draviṇāni ni yacchatu ||
english: May I be the overlord of the cattle; may the Lord of Prosperity place prosperity in me. May the udumbara amulet bestow wealth upon me.

sanskrit: upa maudumbaro maṇiḥ prajayā ca dhanena ca | indreṇa jinvato maṇir ā māgan saha varcasā ||
english: Let the udumbara amulet come to me with offspring and with wealth. Quickened by Indra, may the amulet come to me together with vital lustre.

sanskrit: devo maṇiḥ sapatnahā dhanasā dhanasātaye | paśor annasya bhūmānāṃ gavāṃ sphātiṃ ni yacchatu ||
english: The divine amulet, slayer of rivals, wealth-winning for the winning of wealth — may it bestow the abundance of livestock and food and the thriving of the cattle.

sanskrit: yathāgre tvaṃ vanaspate puṣṭyā saha jajñiṣe | evā dhanasya me sphātim ā dadhātu sarasvatī ||
english: As you, O tree-lord, were born in the beginning together with prosperity, so may Sarasvatī establish for me the thriving of wealth.

sanskrit: ā me dhanaṃ sarasvatī payasphātiṃ ca dhānyam | sinīvāly utā vahād ayaṃ caudumbaro maṇiḥ ||
english: May Sarasvatī bring wealth to me, the flourishing of milk and grain; and may Sinīvālī likewise bring it, and this udumbara amulet too.

sanskrit: tvaṃ maṇīnām adhipā vṛṣāsi tvayi puṣṭaṃ puṣṭapatir jajāna | tvayīme vājā draviṇāni sarvā- -udumbara sa tvam asmat sahasva- -ārād arātim amatiṃ kṣudhaṃ ca ||
english: You are the overlord of amulets, a bull; in you the Lord of Prosperity engendered prosperity. In you are all these prizes and all these riches — O udumbara, you: overpower far from us the demon of niggardliness, the want of wisdom, and hunger.

sanskrit: grāmaṇīr asi grāmaṇīthyāyā abhiṣikto abhi mā siñca varcasā | tejo 'si tejo mayi dhārayādhi rayir asi rayiṃ mayi dhehi ||
english: You are the headman, consecrated to the office of headman — sprinkle me with vital lustre. You are radiance: hold radiance within me supremely. You are wealth: place wealth in me.

sanskrit: puṣṭir asi puṣṭyā mā sam aṅdhi gṛhamedhī gṛhapatiṃ mā kṛṇu | audumbara sa tvam asmāsu rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ ni yaccha rāyaspoṣāya prati muñce ahaṃ tvām ||
english: You are prosperity — anoint me thoroughly with prosperity; as the guardian of the household, make me the master of the house. O udumbara, you: bestow upon us wealth with all its heroes; I release you for the increase of riches.

sanskrit: ayam audumbaro maṇir vīro vīrāya badhyate | sa naḥ sanīṃ madhumatīṃ kṛṇotu rayiṃ ca naḥ sarvavīraṃ ni yacchāt ||
english: This udumbara amulet, heroic, is bound on for the hero. May it make our acquisition sweet and honeyed, and may it bestow upon us wealth with all its heroes.

sanskrit: bhagasya rājñaḥ sumatiṃ gamema yaṃ havante bahudhā mānuṣāsaḥ | karma kṛṇvāno bhagam ā vṛṇīte sa no janeṣu subhagāṃ kṛṇotu ||
english: May we attain the favour of Bhaga the king, whom human beings invoke in many ways. He who acts in accordance with dharma wins Bhaga as his own — may He make us fortunate among the people.

sanskrit: bhagaṃ purastāt pratibudhyamānāḥ paśyema devīm uṣasaṃ vibhātīm | pratīcī śubhrā draviṇena sākaṃ bhagaṃ vahanty aditir na aitu ||
english: Awakening to the east, may we behold the divine Dawn shining forth. The bright one facing toward us, bringing Bhaga together with wealth — may Aditi come to us bearing good fortune.

sanskrit: bhago no adya svite dadhātu devānāṃ panthām abhi no nayeha | arvācī bhadrā sumatir na aitv adhā bhagena samidho no astu ||
english: May Bhaga today, at dawn, bestow upon us favour and lead us here along the path of the gods. May auspicious benevolence come toward us; and then may our kindling-fire glow bright with Bhaga.

sanskrit: bhagena vācam iṣitāṃ vadāni sarasvatīṃ madhumatīṃ suvarcāḥ | bhagena dattam upa medam āgan yathā varcasvān samitim āvadāni ||
english: By Bhaga's impulsion, splendid in lustre, may I speak a speech directed by Sarasvatī, honeyed. May what is given by Bhaga come to me in abundance, so that radiant with lustre I may speak in the assembly.

sanskrit: bhago mā goṣv avatu bhago māvatu dhānye | akṣeṣu strīṣu mā bhago bhago māvatu varcasā ||
english: May Bhaga protect me in cattle; may Bhaga protect me in grain. May Bhaga protect me in dice-play, in women; may Bhaga protect me with vital lustre.

sanskrit: bhago mā sāyam avatu bhago māvatu rātryā | bhago nipadyamāneṣu prātar mā bhaga ā gamat ||
english: May Bhaga protect me at evening; may Bhaga protect me through the night. May Bhaga come to me in the morning among those who lie down.

sanskrit: bhago mā prātar avatu bhago madhyandinaṃ pari | aparāhṇe vayaṃ bhagaṃ vāsa iva pari dadhmahe ||
english: May Bhaga protect me at morning; may Bhaga protect me at midday. In the afternoon we wrap Bhaga around us like a garment.

sanskrit: bhagaṃ devebhyas pari bhagaṃ manuṣyebhyaḥ | divas pṛthivyā aham antarikṣād bhagaṃ vṛṇe | so agne ramatā mayi sa mā prāvatu varcasā ||
english: Bhaga surpassing the gods, Bhaga surpassing men — from heaven, from earth, from the atmosphere I choose Bhaga. May He, O Agni, take delight in me; may He protect me with vital lustre.

sanskrit: bhagaṃ vṛṇānā vadhvaṃ vahanti vaniṃ prayanto bhagam id dhavante | bhagena dattam upa medam āgan viśvaṃ subhūtaṃ draviṇāni bhadrā ||
english: Choosing Bhaga, they bear the bride to her home; proceeding onward they invoke Bhaga alone. May what is given by Bhaga come to me in abundance — all auspicious being, all benign riches.

sanskrit: bhagena devāḥ samaganmahi ya imā viśvā bhuvanābhivaste | prayacchann eti bahudhā vasūni sa no dadhātu yatamad vasiṣṭham ||
english: With Bhaga we have come together with the gods — He who encompasses all these worlds. He goes about bestowing riches in many ways; may He bestow upon us whatever is most excellent.

sanskrit: vāto bhago varuṇo vāyur agniḥ kṣetrasya patnī suhavā no astu | hiraṇyākṣo atipaśyo nṛcakṣāḥ sarvaiḥ sākaṃ sacamāno na ehi ||
english: Vāyu the Bhaga, Varuṇa, Vāyu, Agni — may the mistress of the field be easily invocable for us. He of the golden eye, the far-seer, the man-surveyor — come to us, accompanied by all.

sanskrit: ud ehi deva sūrya saha saubhāgyena | saharṣabhasya vājena sahāvataṃkaraṇena ||
english: Arise, O divine Sūrya, together with good fortune; together with the prize-winning strength of the bull, together with the means of protection.

sanskrit: hiraṇyayenety ekā ||
english: [Colophon:] "With the golden one" — thus the single verse.
